newsitem.title: CHILE: RESEARCH ALERT - TELEX UPGRADED TO BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - TELEX UPGRADED TO BUY.

text.p: ING Barings said it has upgraded long-distance telecom Telex Chile to buy from hold, citing the company's decision to restructure its management which should boost its operating performance.
Analyst Ricardo Fernandez said he has upgraded the company on the basis of a potential turnaround at Telex which has suffered more from low long-distance rates than its competitors.
"Telex could achieve competitive margins if management backed less agressive discounting and improved cash generation," said the report.
Telex is one of nine companies battling in Chile's highly competitive multicarrier long-distance service.

The carrier reported net first half profits fell to 3.16 billion pesos from 6.74 billion pesos in the same period last year. Operating earnings also slumped to 1.6 billion pesos from 3.66 billion pesos. ((-- Margaret Orgill, Santiago newsroom, 562-699-5595 x212))
